title: UPESSC UP Headmaster Recruitment 2026
summary: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission UPESSC , has released a notification on its official website for the recruitment of UP Headmaster Posts. This recruitment is for 1172 positions. UPESSC Application Form has started on 23 October 2026 & the candidates can apply until the 22 November 2026 . Minimum age is 30 Years & The Maximum Age Is 62 Years as on 01 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPESSC UP Headmaster Recruitment 2026. Link are given below. ( Advt. No. 09/2026 )
category_wise_vacancies: Candidates must have a Postgraduate Degree with at least 50% marks from a recognized university, along with a B.Ed. or B.P.Ed. degree. They must also have at least 4 years of teaching experience as a Lecturer / Assistant Teacher in Classes 9–12 at a recognized institution, or 4 years of experience as a Junior High School Headmaster. The experience certificate must be issued by the competent authority.
How To Fill UPESSC UP Headmaster Online Form 2026

Interested candidates who wish to apply for the UPESSC post can submit their application online before 22 November 2026. Use the click here link provided below under important link section to apply directly. Alternatively, visit the official website of UPESSC to complete the application process online. Make sure to complete the application before the deadline 22 November 2026 .
